name: Pulse Music v4.0.4 - Soft Pastel UI, Multi-Colour Moving Ambient Lyrics & Universal Dolby Atmos
body:
# Pulse Music v4.0.4 - Soft Pastel UI, Multi-Colour Moving Ambient Lyrics & Universal Dolby Atmos

Official multi-platform release and global OTA update for **Android**, **Windows**, **Orion Store**, **F-Droid**, and **Obtainium**.

---

### 🎨 Soft Pastel Theme & Purged Neon Colors
- **Soft Aesthetic Palette**: Completely removed harsh neon green highlights across dialogs, splash, settings, shelf badges, and cookies in favor of a soft lavender/periwinkle palette (`#A788FA`, `#818CF8`, `#C4B5FD`).
- **Hearing Safety & Indicators**: Refreshed volume protection, icons, and update dialogs with soothing, cohesive pastels.

### 🌌 Multi-Colour Moving Ambient Light Behind Lyrics
- **Dynamic Organic Aurora**: Floating, organic radial gradient light effect in the background of full-screen and card lyrics driven directly by the album art palette.
- **Fluid Ambient Animation**: Continuous smooth orbital drift synchronized with track visuals for an immersive listening experience.

### ⚡ Instant Material 3 Expressive Color Sync
- **Album Palette Color Extraction**: Fixed palette extraction to prioritize vibrant and dominant swatches from album art, completely eliminating incorrect random pink/red seed fallbacks.
- **Instant Snappy Transitions**: Reduced transition duration from 800ms down to 150ms so colors synchronize immediately when songs change.

### 🎧 Universal Dolby Atmos DSP Controls
- **Selectable Spatial Profiles**: Dynamic, Music, Cinema, and Voice sound profiles directly accessible in Settings and Audio Effects with clear subtitles.
- **Universal Software DSP**: Removed hardware-gated restriction so Pulse Music's internal Dolby Atmos software audio processor runs on all Android devices.

### 📜 Lyrics Blur & Fluid 120 FPS Synchronization
- **Apple Music Depth-of-Field Blur**: Enhanced line blur constants (6dp–20dp) with smooth progression for distant lyrics.
- **Zero-Lag Text Sync**: Removed duplicate shadow text allocations to guarantee lag-free, perfectly synced lyric wipe animations.

### 🔔 Intelligent Update Notifications
- **Single Notification Rule**: Exactly one system status-bar alert per remote release tag.
- **In-App Update Dialog**: Checking for updates inside the app presents an interactive in-app update progress dialog with live byte counts, avoiding notification spam.

### 🏷️ Clean Brand Consolidation
- Unified all branding and descriptions under **Pulse Music** / **Pulse Music Studio**.
